canonical_data: A generated Markdown wiki plus a machine-readable graph.json knowledge graph, compiled from immutable raw source captures.
strengths: Fully offline heuristic provider; no API keys required for the core workflow
Typed graph edges (extracted/inferred/ambiguous) with contradiction detection and confidence bounds
Broad export surface: HTML, SVG, GraphML, Cypher/Neo4j, Obsidian notes and canvases
MCP server plus direct install hooks for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot, and others
weaknesses: Very large CLI surface (dozens of subcommands) raises the learning curve versus a focused note app
No repository push since 2026-06-30 at time of review, roughly two and a half months
Single maintaining organization with a comparatively small community (685 stars, 79 forks)
Sharper concept/entity/claim extraction depends on adding a local or cloud LLM provider
why_it_matters: A self-contained, provenance-aware knowledge-graph engine that serves both a human wiki and MCP-connected agents without requiring any single agent host.
